By the present bail application, the applicant seeks pre- arrest bail in FIR No. 410/2025 dated 11.05.2025, registered at Police Station Adarsh Nagar, for offences under Sections 376/506/509 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
It is pointed out that the alleged incident relates to years 2022 and 2023 and even as per the allegations, the last incident took place on 13.08.2023.

3. The learned Senior Counsel for the applicant submits that initially on a complaint given by the prosecutrix, a Zero FIR was recorded in Police Station Adarsh Nagar on 24.08.2023.
4.

He submits that the FIR was thereafter transferred to the authorities in Noida on 09.11.2023.
5.
He submits that ultimately the present FIR was registered This is a digitally signed order.

6.

The allegations made in the present FIR are that the applicant met the prosecutrix on Jeevansathi.com, whereafter on multiple occasions, the applicant sexually exploited the prosecutrix on a false pretext of marriage and raped her.

It is alleged that on 07.11.2022, the applicant Aman Garg vs State N.C.T. Of Delhi on 30 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42408634/

sentences.text: 7. The learned Senior Counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix concealed information with respect to her background.
He submits that the FIR has been filed in order to extort money from the applicant.
He submits that the applicant now apprehends that he would be subjected to coercive action.
8. Issue notice.
9. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.
10. Notice be issued to the victim through the Investigating Officer.

11. Considering that the present FIR has been registered after almost two years of the alleged incidents the State is directed not to arrest the applicant till the next date of hearing, subject to the applicant joining and cooperating with the investigation.
12. The applicant is directed not to contact the prosecutrix in any manner whatsoever.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J MAY 30, 2025 /
